title: Create a retry decorator module from scratch
description: Create a new file app/retry.py containing a retry decorator. It must accept attempts (int) and exceptions (tuple of exception types), retry the wrapped function up to `attempts` times when one of those exceptions is raised, and re-raise the last exception if every attempt fails. It must preserve the wrapped function's __name__.
acceptanceCriteria: app/retry.py exists and defines a retry decorator
